name: G'rho
description: G'rho was a planet in Wild Space on the Shiritoku Spur and was where forests of juvica grew. A remote colony, its colonists raised duncows and built Boku Settlement near a rich vein of crimson ore. Dev Sibwarra's family moved there shortly after his birth in 11 BBY when they fled Chandrila.
lead_paragraphs: G'rho was a planet in Wild Space on the Shiritoku Spur and was where forests of juvica grew. A remote colony, its colonists raised duncows and built Boku Settlement near a rich vein of crimson ore. Dev Sibwarra's family moved there shortly after his birth in 11 BBY when they fled Chandrila.
